dict.string: AlwyChat uses the microphone for voice messages and calls.
AlwyChat uses the camera to take photos and videos for your chats, and for video calls.
AlwyChat lets you pick photos and videos to send.
AlwyChat saves photos and videos from your chats to your library when you ask.
AlwyChat sends your location to a chat only when you choose to share it.
AlwyChat can use Face ID to unlock the app if you turn on the app lock.
